change: Add diagnostics separating finite imperative/subjunctive plain-form constructions from infinitival plain-form constructions.
Preserve finiteness as clause status even where the plain form occurs in both systems.
Clarify the three verb-based non-finite form-types and separately identify verbless clauses rather than treating verbless as a verb form.
Distinguish absent subjects from hollow clauses missing a non-subject constituent; preserve limits on matrix recoverability.
Add Chapter 14 evidence distinguishing complement, modifier and supplement uses of non-finite clauses.
Extend the source citation to Chapter 14's explicit exclusion of modal auxiliaries from all non-finite clause form-types.
